title: Cactus in a pot with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id="potGrad" cx="50%" cy="40%" r="60%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#E8793A"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#B84A1A"/>
    </radialGradient>
    <linearGradient id="cactusGrad" x1="0%" y1="0%" x2="100%" y2="100%">
      <stop offset="0%" stop-color="#4CAF50"/>
      <stop offset="100%" stop-color="#2E7D32"/>
    </linearGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Pot -->
  <path d="M28 72 L22 92 Q22 96 26 96 L74 96 Q78 96 78 92 L72 72 Z" fill="url(#potGrad)"/>
  <path d="M25 72 L75 72 L74 76 L26 76 Z" fill="#F0945A"/>

  <!-- Pot rim highlight -->
  <rect x="24" y="69" width="52" height="6" rx="3" fill="#F0945A"/>
  <rect x="24" y="69" width="52" height="3" rx="1.5" fill="#FFB87A"/>

  <!-- Cactus main body -->
  <rect x="40" y="30" width="20" height="44" rx="10" fill="url(#cactusGrad)"/>
  <!-- Cactus highlight -->
  <rect x="43" y="34" width="5" height="36" rx="2.5" fill="#66BB6A" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Left arm -->
  <path d="M40 48 L30 48 Q24 48 24 54 L24 60 Q24 66 30 66 L40 66" fill="none" stroke="#3E8E41" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M40 48 L30 48 Q24 48 24 54 L24 60 Q24 66 30 66 L40 66" fill="none" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M28 50 L28 62" stroke="#66BB6A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Right arm -->
  <path d="M60 40 L70 40 Q76 40 76 46 L76 54 Q76 60 70 60 L60 60" fill="none" stroke="#3E8E41" stroke-width="9" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M60 40 L70 40 Q76 40 76 46 L76 54 Q76 60 70 60 L60 60" fill="none" stroke="#4CAF50" stroke-width="6" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M72 44 L72 56" stroke="#66BB6A" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" opacity="0.7"/>

  <!-- Spines (small light dots) -->
  <circle cx="42" cy="36" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="38" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="40" cy="46" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="52" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="42" cy="58" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="58" cy="64" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="44" cy="68" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="30" r="1.2" fill="#A5D6A7"/>

  <!-- Eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="45" cy="48" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#1B2A1B"/>
  <ellipse cx="55" cy="48" rx="3" ry="3.5" fill="#1B2A1B"/>
  <!-- Eye shine -->
  <circle cx="46" cy="46.5" r="1.2" fill="#B9F6CA"/>
  <circle cx="56" cy="46.5" r="1.2" fill="#B9F6CA"/>

  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d="M44 54 Q50 60 56 54" fill="none" stroke="#1B2A1B" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx="40" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.6"/>
  <circle cx="60" cy="54" r="2.5" fill="#FF8A80" opacity="0.6"/>

  <!-- Flower on top -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="26" r="4" fill="#FF7043"/>
  <circle cx="46" cy="24" r="3" fill="#FFAB91"/>
  <circle cx="54" cy="24" r="3" fill="#FFAB91"/>
  <circle cx="48" cy="22" r="3" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="52" cy="22" r="3" fill="#FFCCBC"/>
  <circle cx="50" cy="25" r="2" fill="#FFE082"/>
</svg>
